phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Government Refinancing Need / Historical Continuity Promotion Gate
purpose: Determine whether the Ministry of Finance government-debt refinancing/principal-repayment reference target can be promoted from a short partial annual history to an observed behaviour-over-time series without mixing forecasts, gross financing need, maturity/refixing proxies or repricing parameters.

target.concept: Annual Ministry of Finance principal repayments/refinancing of government public debt on the national-law debt-management boundary.
excludes: gross financing need as a combined measure
temporary/liquidity-management financing maturing in the year of issuance
debt maturing within one year as a proxy

promotion_criteria.rationale_for_minimum: Match or exceed the already accepted annual government_effective_interest_rate reference history, which contains ten annual observations for 2014-2023. The requirement is about behaviour-over-time observability, not parameter identification.

revision_rule: When multiple official Ministry values exist for the same completed year and concept, retain the highest-precedence later observed/reconciled status. Forecast, planned and estimate values never override an observed completed-year value. Record discarded candidates in provenance rather than silently replacing them.

definition_bridge.canonical_interpretation: Principal/capital repayments and refinancing of government securities on account of government public debt under national legislation, on the stated Ministry debt-management boundary.
accepted_wording_variants: Refinancing of the government public debt
definition_bridge.bridge_requirement: The source table/footnote must make clear that the amount is the debt-refinancing/principal-repayment component of annual financing needs, distinct from the budget deficit and from any separately reported pre-financing.
definition_bridge.prohibited_bridge: Do not treat total financing needs/gross financing need, issuance, maturity shares or pre-financing as the refinancing observation.

candidate_window.note: Candidate documents were discovered before repository materialization. This contract freezes selection, precedence and promotion rules before any extended series is committed or the reference registry is promoted.

validation_checks: all numeric values finite and positive
zero forecast/planned/estimate rows in canonical series
source URLs point to official Ministry of Finance documents
2015 observed retrospective value must override the earlier 50.0 estimate
2016 observed retrospective value must override the earlier 48.6 plan
2024 value must come from a completed-year/year-end updated report rather than the November in-year plan
mechanism status remains DEFERRED and repricing parameter m[t] remains unidentified

promotion_effect.if_all_criteria_pass: Set government_refinancing_need to OBSERVED_SERIES_AVAILABLE as an annual behaviour-over-time reference target.

failure_rule: If continuity, source status, definition bridge or precedence fails, retain PARTIAL_SERIES_AVAILABLE and do not fill or infer the missing year.
